notes.title: [0.23.1] Update and Server Instability Notice
notes.notes:
0.23.1 Update is a maintenance-free deployment and client update. Please quit and restart Steam to receive this patch update. 

Server Instability

After we deployed our patch, servers in all regions began experiencing periods of instability and inability to join games at around 11 PM KST. We hope to avoid this issue from happening again in the future by testing other methods of distribution.

Bug Fixes


 Can no longer attack while dead/downed.
 Sissela will attack and take damage properly when in a restricted area  
(Sissela's rank ban has been lifted).
 Fiora's Garde (R) no longer cancels when reactivating.
 Emma's Bunnymorph (E) sometimes slowed a tad too much (This fix may take up to an hour to be applied).
 Traps should now properly detect enemies inside the bush.
 Knockbacks should now work properly.


Separately, the following issue was fixed by deploying a patch to our API server at around 8:40 PM KST. We have addressed a bug that prevented promotions to start after players received 99 LP. 

We apologize to those who have lost precious time and LP due to today's server instability and bugs. As a token of our apology, we will be sending 300 NP to all players this Friday at approximately 00:00 KST.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Unstable Server and [0.23.0 Update] Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
The changes went live without maintenance.

1. Unstable Server Issues


 We have been working on fixing the bug when dead characters were able to attack through an update that doesn’t require maintenance. 
 Due to this, some matching issues occurred on our battle server.
 We rolled back to the previous server state, which didn’t require maintenance.
 This was not a code error, but rather a build error occasionally occurs. (This happens when we push the test build into the live build and an error occurs during copy)
 We will come up with a way to avoid these kinds of build errors when pushing updates without maintenance.


2. What we’re focusing on solving through today’s update:


 Downed characters will not be able to attack. 
 Sissela will attack and take damage properly when in a restricted area
 Knockbacks will correctly work. 
 Various other small things that are quick fixes.

notes.notes:
Hey gang, Aesop here with the patch notes! Finally! There’s a couple small changes; tweaks to numbers and some bug fixes that you should check out below. 
Remember, as always, this is a minor patch - only the last digit has changed. There will be a major update coming up with the release of Emma, the Magnificent, next week! (Along with some other stuff. Remember to check out our roadmap to get a glimpse of what else is headed your way.) 

Character

High Pick Rate Criteria
A specific character-to-weapon pick rate that is higher than 8.3% (~1.5/18) means that one character + weapon combination is often found multiple times in a single match.
If a pick rate exceeds 8.3% in top ranks, this indicates a high possibility of a problem - even if the win rate is low.
In overall statistics, the pick rate is more loosely based on the free character rotation.
Chiara (rapier) and Shoichi (dagger) both have high pick rates in higher tiers, leading to their adjustments. 

Character-weapon mode correction 
Some characters have (vastly) different solo/duo/squad rates with different weapons, so certain weapons can result in a low win rate in certain modes. Notably, Hyejin (Shuriken) and Yuki (Dual Swords) have low win rates in all three modes. This is difficult to adjust as they share weapons with other characters.
In next week’s update (0.22.0), we will change the current mode correction value from character to character-weapon combination to help close the gap between weapon types on characters.

 We will remove the default Saved Plans Recommendations from the shared list.

Handling improvements

 If you right-click an area where you cannot access, you will move to a section where you can go without stopping.
 No longer unable to get items after clicking them in boxes. (Clicking and moving your mouse a little bit is no longer recognized, so you should be able to loot more smoothly.)

Optimization

 Optimization of bushes

Other improvements

 Beginner video guides recommended in game for players under level 10.
 When you open the scoreboard (Tab) in spectator mode, the order applied is fixed to team order.
 Sound effects now occur when you install or use a trap.

Characters
Character Stats and Balance Update
Many of you are curious about our balance methodology -- we base our balance decisions on data and statistical analysis. By default, four indicators are used for average number of kills, win rate, rank, and pick rate. These are complemented by detailed analysis on other factors like skill order, item builds, and mastery data.

Some of the balance changes are centered around high-tier players. If certain data points from high rank matches are outliers, they become a priority for adjustment. Naturally, we also look at any of the aforementioned indicators being outliers as well. If the key indicators are mixed, we observe further. When the win rate and the average number of kills don't line up, we approach with caution. Balance can be greatly compromised if we make even the tiniest wrong adjustment.

Statistics mainly respond to 'dramatic' values. If the number of kills is significantly high, action is likely to be required in a different sense other than 'balance'. Character balance also varies greatly by mode, which is where our current system is limited. Because the mode-specific values have been developed per character, it is difficult to adjust if other weapons are strong per mode. For example, assault rifle Aya is strong in solo, but in squads, data shows pistol performs better. Although Aya's pistol in solo and Aya's assault rifle in squad show poorer performance, they cannot be adjusted.

This is often the case with the statistics of the played modes vs actual patches going in different directions. To address these limitations, we are developing a "character-weapon specific mode adjustments."

notes.title: Roadmap Update (Nov. 27, 2020)
notes.notes:
Hello all survivors of Lumia Island. 

It’s your friend Aesop here with a look into the (near) future of Eternal Return.

First, the roadmap has been updated.
https://playeternalreturn.com/roadmap

We created this roadmap as a reference for anyone to check what’s coming -- but it should not be interpreted as the “official schedule”. This schedule is highly likely to change during development.

Balance changes, bug fixes, and other small updates are excluded from this roadmap.

Improving security

The use of illegal programs is one of the biggest enemies for all games as it undermines the value of fair-play.
We cannot share the exact details of the process on the patch notes or the roadmap, but improving security has become one of our current main goals for upcoming updates.

 We will keep adding new features to detect and prevent the use of illegal programs in each update.
 In our current system, there are many instances where the encryption process is entered or server checks happen which adversely affects performance. Going forward, we will conduct security improvement simultaneously with optimization.
 If you experience a decline in performance after these updates, please give us as much feedback as possible in order for us to respond quickly to these issues.


Ranked mode and Reconnection
Ranked mode and Reconnection features have been pushed back two weeks to give priority to the security improvements.

 We will not be using the "animal" league names that were used in the original Black Survival, but instead will use a more familiar system. More details to come soon. 
 We are also planning on having an Open API ready around the time Ranked mode will be out so that anyone can access game data.


Quantum Blink

We will also be implementing a new feature: Quantum Blink.

 Quantum Blink is a short-distance teleport feature with a long cooldown given to all characters. (similar to "Flash" in… some other games)
 Although Saved Plans and builds play a big part in deciding the victories and losses, we want to introduce additional variables through mechanics and outplay potential.


Quantum Blink may very likely make a big difference in gameplay patterns.

 More diverse ways to initiate combat.
 Adding more ways to weave skills together (Quantum Blink + skill) or dodge enemy skills.
 Giving more opportunities to some characters that lack lockdown or chase more potential to secure the kill on their enemies.
 Diversifying ways to kill enemies by allowing combination of basic movement features with Quantum Blink.


New changes can always have unforeseen side effects.
For example, as Quantum Blink makes it easier to escape, games may slow down.

It's important (and fun) to have dynamic and aggressive gameplay, so we will prepare a number of additional measures to ensure that new features are used aggressively and actively.

 After the introduction of Quantum Blink, we will quickly try to adjust balance according to the newly-improved advantages and disadvantages of each character.
 Similar to how we increased the weight of the number of kills in Solo mode, it will allow us to keep increasing and adjusting modes in the future.
 We will be able to add effects when killing a player, like decreasing the cooldown of Quantum Blink, recovering HP/SP, etc.


Adding new weapon types to 3 existing characters + Character-Weapon balance

Here are the new weapon types to be added in our December update:

 Xiukai - Dagger
 Sissela - Throw
 Yuki - Dual Swords


We will continue to add new weapon types to existing characters in future updates. 

 As we mentioned in our Q&A, we want each character to have a variety in weapon choices. Excluding characters with a very specific weapon (like Hart), we plan on adding at least two different weapon types per character.


Adjustments based on Character-Weapon-Mode values

 As the number of character and weapon combinations increases, it is becoming increasingly difficult to balance the game merely by looking at character and weapon pairs - for example,  Hyejin-Shuriken. 
 Because the current mode-specific adjustment values are only applied per character, each mode now has a specific weapon that is difficult to use. For example, Hyunwoo has poor performance with Tonfa in Solo, but uses it more efficiently in Squad
 We want to add character-weapon adjustments per mode, allowing each character to be playable no matter the mode.
 Theoretically, by analyzing current data, stats for Hyejin-Shuriken should need a buff in each mode.


New character
Emma will be joining Lumia Island in December.

Sudden changes may occur during development, so please understand if any sudden changes occur and keep supporting us in the future. You all have been incredible so far and we’re absolutely floored and humbled by all the love you have given us.

Thank you.

notes.title: Mouse Right Click Bug Fix
notes.notes:
At 4 am PST, we implemented an urgent fix, without maintenance, to fix a bug that caused delay between normal attacks by continuously right clicking.

The fix will be gradually uploaded to all each of our server shards, and we expect that it will take between 1 to 2 hours to have it fully implemented.

This is the first time we've tried to implement a fix on live servers without maintenance - if an unexpected problem arises, we will proceed with emergency maintenance.

As for an issue we've seen regarding the range of attack being longer than the range of vision, attack range and vision range occasionally not matching may come from a minor mismatch between the range of vision according to the server vs the range of vision accord to the client. This may require additional time for a more in-depth fix.

We hope everyone still is having a good time in the game! Let us know if you have any issue.

notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Aesop here bringing you the notes for update 0.19.4. This is the last minor patch before our next regular update which will introduce Silvia.

Mastery
We’re adjusting some masteries that would overlap with item stats or levels, being highly efficient in the late-game.

 Crafting mastery: item bonus per mastery level 0.8% → 0.7%
 HP mastery: max HP increase per mastery level 1.6% —> 1.3%
 Defense mastery: Normal Attack Damage Reduction per mastery level 1.5% → 1.3%
 Meditation mastery: max SP increase per mastery level 3% → 2%


Character

We are combining LP variations by character and by weapon since our last update.

For example, top-tier Solo Hyejin (Bow) had a win rate of 9.2%, which is 2.9% lower than average, but her average kills were 1.85, which was 0.3 above the average. When data points like win rate and average kills show us different results, average LP received with that character can become a tertiary datapoint. For Hyejin (bow), the average LP received by players was slightly above average.

notes.title: Minor Patch - 0.19.3 (2020. 11. 16)
notes.notes:
During the 3 days that followed Shoichi's update, all data indicating character performance, excluding pick rate, was rather low, delaying our decision to release any changes.

When a new character is released, we usually see a high pick rate for the first 3 days before it decreases again, but Shoichi hovered around 15% through the weekend. Players were learning how to play him, increasing the amount of data we have for character performance. We recorded higher than average kills for him.

The culmination of all this data means we're pushing a patch for Shoichi a bit early, and moving Wednesday's typical balance patch to Friday for us to study his new data.

Shoichi
As an assassin, Shoichi is a character more powerful when managing space and staying at a distance, but a bit weaker in melee. However, due to his low HP, he was more difficult to handle than we initially thought. When facing Shoichi, it required more micro-focused skills or targeted equipment to counter him.

Focusing on his level 6 power-spike, we are reducing the early game power of skill amplification builds, and are changing the (hard to counter) root from Ruthless (R).

notes.title: Teaming Rule Update
notes.notes:
Hello survivors of Lumia Island,

We'd like to share a quick annoucement regarding with you today.

Teaming is something that greatly damages the value of a fair game.

However, determining what is or isn't teaming can be difficult, so it can be a difficult problem to solve for many battle royale games.

Deciding if something was or wasn't teaming may vary slightly depending on the context and the person making a decision. Doing any of the following for the sake of teaming will result in punishment:

 Sharing food or items with a player who is NOT your teammate.
 Following another player who is NOT your teammate for a long time, before the last restricted area is designated, and constantly avoiding combat with that player.
 Any other act judged to be excessive and with an obvious intention of teaming based on discretion.

You may receive an indefinite ban if the teaming is determined to be premeditated.

We will keep trying to prevent teaming through continuous improvements of the game system on the long term and we will keep doing our best to develop a fair and equal game.

notes.title: EU and SA Server Extension + Mode changes
notes.notes:
We heard you all! Thanks to feedback from the community and performance of the servers themselves, we're extending the time of the Europe server by an additional 3 hours to be open for a total of 7 hours and the South America server by an additional 1 hour to be open for a total of 5 hours

Europe

EU Server: 5 PM - 12 AM CEST

We will also always have Solo mode available while the servers are open. We'll have a team mode (duo/trio) on rotation throughout the week.

The EU server has shown solid performance and matchmaking, but the EU population still isn't quite ready to sustain a 24/7 server, (Even the NA server is seeing some long queues at off-peak times) but this is a great first step.

South America

SA Server: 6 PM to 11 PM BRT

The South America server population is still rather low, but has shown some increase. We'll be adding an additional hour to the server as well.

As for modes on the South America server, duo mode will be temporarily suspended, leaving only Solo and Squad.

We have an easy website link to help you follow the server times and modes, check it out here:
https://www.playeternalreturn.com/schedule

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.17.0 (2020. 10. 14) - Edited
notes.notes:
New character - Chiara
Chiara, the Fallen, is the 15th character to join Lumia Island in Eternal Return!

Stigma (Passive)
When Chiara hits an enemy with a skill, she carves a Stigma into them, reducing their defense.

 The Stigma remains for 6 seconds. Chiara can apply a maximum of 4 Stigmas to the same enemy.
 When the enemy reaches the maximum amount of Stigmas, Chiara's movement speed is increased for 6 seconds.
 Defense reduction per Stigma: 4/6/8%
 Movement speed increase when reaching 4 Stigmas: 4/7/10%


Hand of Corruption (Q)
Chiara casts out corrupted energy in the targeted direction, dealing damage to all enemies it hits.

 Cooldown 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s
 SP Cost 50/60/70/80/90
 Range 5m (cone)
 Damage: 60/100/140/180/200 + AP 60%
 The corrupted energy remains for 0.25 seconds, reducing the movement speed of enemies by 30%.
 Hold the skill down for 0.5 seconds to cast out the corrupted energy further and in a straight line.(12m)
 Using the skill short-ranged reduces its cooldown by 20%.


Depraved Prayer (W)
Chiara divines a shield, absorbing damage. The shield remains for 6 seconds.
If the shield is not depleted after 3 seconds, she can reactivate the skill again, making it explode, dealing damage to enemies in range.

 Cooldown 15/14/13/12/11s
 SP Cost 50/60/70/80/90
 Shield absorption 100/140/180/220/260 + AP 60%
 Shield explosion range 5.5m
 Shield explosion damage 80/120/160/200/240 + AP 60%


Mania (E)
Chiara sends out a shackle in the targeted direction, dealing damage to enemies hit and linking them to Chiara. If the link is maintained for 1.75 seconds, she deals damage and roots the enemy for 1.5 seconds.

 Cooldown 15/13/11/9/7s
 SP Cost 80
 Range 8m (Shackle max range: 10m)
 Damage if hit 40/60/80/100/120 + AP 30%
 Damage if rooted 70/110/150/190/230 + AP 70%


Plague (R)
Chiara channels the darkness inside of her, temporarily transforming into a fallen angel.
While transformed, her normal attacks are ranged, her max HP is increased, and she Plagues the area around her. Enemies inside of the Plague receive damage every second and Chiara recovers HP in proportion to damage dealt.

 Cooldown 100/90/80s
 SP Cost 100/120/140
 Auto-attack range 5.25m, Plague damage range 6.5m, max Judgement range 8m
 Plague damage per second 25/35/45 + AP 15%
 Recovers HP based on 10/20/30% damage dealt.


While Plague is activated, she gains vision of all enemies that have the maximum amount of Stigmas, and she can cast Last Judgement.

Last Judgement: Chiara can crash down upon an enemy with the maximum amount of Stigmas, dealing true damage and ending the Plague.

 Judgement damage 200/300/400 + AP 120%
 Killing enemies with Last Judgement reduces the cooldown of Plague by 50%.


In-game System

Saved Plan System
The Saved Plan feature was expanded and improved.

 Multiple Saved Plans
 You can now save up to 5 different plans per character.
 Saved Plans are saved on our server. Even if you log in to another computer, you will be able to see/use your Saved Plans.
 Changing Plans in a match
 You can switch Saved Plans while in a match.
 Take your strategy up a notch by dedicating 1 or 2 plans to food, traps or other items.
 Saved Plans sharing feature
 You can share Saved Plans you made.
 You can also import Plans from other players.
 Filter Saved Plans per number of use or shares.


Observer Mode
You can now spectate Custom Games.

 Spectators will have vision of all players on the map.
 Additional features for the observer mode will continuously be added in the future.


Character spawning location changed
Moved the spawn of characters for areas where they were around too many containers or too far from any containers.

 Spawning locations for starting areas or hyperloop teleporting have been changed to reduce irregularities.


XP for slaying wild animals
XP for slaying wild animals per level increased.

 Chicken 80 → 80 + 8 per level
 Bat 140 → 140 + 14 per level
 Boar 200 → 180 + 18 per level
 Wild Dog 240 → 200 + 20 per level
 Wolf 240 → 200 + 20 per level
 Bear 350 → 250 + 25 per level
 Wickeline 0 → 30 per level

Increased XP for killing wild animals and XP required for weapon and defense mastery level up.

 Weapon mastery Lv. 2 required XP 200 → 220, Lv. 20 required XP 2720 → 3280
 Defense mastery Lv. 2 required XP 200 (not changed), Lv. 20 required XP 3440 → 4160

Bear 'Ground Slam' skill cast time increased 0.49s → 0.55s

Level difference bonus adjustment

 Bonus XP given per level difference with the highest level survivor on the island 15% → 18%


Camera location adjustments

 The position of the camera was adjusted to be a bit higher.
 Camera view is still affected by vision range, the viewpoint for the most recent/furthest camera will be slightly further away.


Lobby System

Home restructure
A shiny home screen will be the first thing you see upon loading!

 Provides more convenient access to things like Patch Notes in-game.
 Added a "Character" tab. You can find additional info about characters in this tab.


Name change

 You can buy name change tickets in the Store.


Credits
Special thanks to you!

 You can see the list of our Founders and Alpha testers by going to the Settings > Credits.


LP System changes
If you saw your LP disappear after the Open Beta, that was intended!

 LP will be divided per mode: Solo, Duo, and Squad.
 In order to prevent new players from encountering experienced players at the start, we will be distributing 30% of your current LP into each mode.
 Adjusting premade team LP
 Compensation for pre-made Duos and Squads (pre-made teams matchmaking and final LP calculations counted as slightly higher LP) increased.
 We are trying to limit players intentionally matching with low LP players to gain more LP. If the LP difference between the members of the premade team is higher than a certain amount, it will be adjusted to match the highest LP player.


Reporting players
Hover over the offending player's name in the post-match screen for justice.

 You can now report players directly from the results screen at the end of the match.
 You can select various reasons for reporting like teaming, verbal abuse, negative attitude, etc.
 The feature to add detail to reports will be added later. If you want to add comments to your report, send in a support ticket by going to Settings >  Support > Customer Support.


Balance

Completing your weapon first is very important. However, most routes and strategies now tend to be overly dependent on this.

To ensure that the completion of the weapon does not affect initial combat capability too much, we want to strengthen mid-level items to reduce the sudden increase in strength after the weapon is complete.

Also, we want to strengthen the basic stats of characters little by little, reducing the influence of the first item on early fights. However, changing the base stats can have a significant impact on balance, so we will be adjusting this very slowly and carefully. 

On the other hand, the handling and dodging difficulty of skills should be balanced --  some skills are currently just too slow. We want to try and find a balance point for this by slightly adjusting the speed of some skill projectiles over time.

notes.title: Minor Patch - 0.16.3 (2020.09.16)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, Aesop here with some quick adjustments and changes for a couple things. We’ve added some reasoning behind some of the changes as well. We might still be lacking a bit of context, but we're always trying to improve, so we ask for your understanding going forward.

Character
Three modes require different focuses and specialties per character and it makes it harder to balance. Each mode has its own playstyle and fun, and the number of players in each mode keeps growing. The proportion of players in each mode is pretty even, so we are trying to keep equal priority when it comes to balancing.
However, this is a long process as there are many elements affected by balancing. We’ve kept a max of 15% balance adjustment allowed in each mode -- some characters are getting close to this maximum. We will prepare balance measures other than these mode adjustments for future updates.

Spotlight - Isol

 Instead of weakening the synergy between Semtex Bomb (Q) and Rebel Assault (W), we want to improve the balance between pistols and assault rifles by strengthening synergy of normal attacks with assault rifles and Semtex Bomb.
 Although you can increase the effects of Semtex Bomb using normal attacks of the assault rifles, the synergy between Semtex Bomb and Rebel Assault with pistols results in less than ideal interactions.

notes.title: Update adjustments & Open Beta Extension
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Eternal Return team here with a scheduling adjustment and some news for the future.

Our update for post matchmaking character selection + no duplicate characters was scheduled for release tomorrow, but it has been pushed back one week.
We are very sorry for the delay.

There will still be a minor patch tomorrow as planned, but it will not include this particular feature.
In order to test and fix unexpected issues that may appear, we will extend the Open Beta for one more week.
The Open Beta will now end September 30th.

We still have many concerns regarding the Early Access release of Eternal Return as this will be our first experience with it.
We are particularly concerned about the billing system as there are a lot of requirements to meet, as well as setting up an entire refund system, which makes it a big project in itself.
Transferring all data from the Open Beta demo version to the official client will also be a big project that we are trying to make as smooth as possible.

Naturally, there are a lot of new features that are necessary to have by Early Access.
Although experienced players like to test out new Saved Plans and builds, casual and new players have expressed that Saved Plans can be a more confusing obstacle to overcome.
Due to this, the implementation of a feature allowing players to adopt multiple Saved Plans created by other players seems essential.

We are also lucky enough to have several people streaming Eternal Return, highlighting the urgency of a spectator feature.

Both the Demo (Open Beta) and Early Access are internal systems that rely on Steam.
There are very few examples of Demo versions of Free-to-Play games on Steam, so there are many elements that require consultation or permission from Steam themselves.
Due to the situation in North America, the aforementioned consultation process has slowed.

Our development team wants to extend the Open Beta more than anyone else.

We will notify you if an additional extension is possible after September 30th, depending on the development progress and consultation with Steam.

Unfortunately, we cannot implement bug fixes and new features during the extended period.

We will keep working hard to bring you the best version of Eternal Return possible. Thank you for reading.

notes.title: Teaming and Ban Update
notes.notes:
The Eternal Return team feels that it is necessary to bring you clarity and information regarding Teaming and similar issues some of you have witnessed in the game.

1. Originally, we did not have a codified policy on dealing with teaming or similar issues prior to the Sissela Update (0.15.0). We will not be retroactively suspending accounts reported before then. However, we continue to closely monitor the players who have been reported.

2. We ask you to please keep in mind that we're still in Beta -- we hope that you all can be understanding if, and when, you find things are not ready yet. With the launch into Early Access, we will implement a player report function that players will be able to use at the end of each match. 

3. The team has felt that many players have mistaken the LP rank system as an official rank system in game. While, in the current state of the game, it's the closest thing we have to rank, but in reality, it's just a temporary system to help us with matchmaking. The actual Ranked mode and system will be added to the game later during Early Access.

4. There have been reports of various situations of players violating our ToS, and we will be taking measures on those proven to be in violation. The best thing you can all do to help us at this time is to make sure to send us videos/screenshots with your reports to help facilitate our judgement of each report. Even if the report is found not to be breaking our ToS, we will still keep a record of the report and monitor the reported player.

5. The Terms of Service has been amended to include policy for things like frequent inactive players and players who stalk other players across different matches.
Currently you can report players through the specific channels we have on Discord or through our Support platform here: https://eternalreturn.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new
The following accounts have been absolutely confirmed and have been temporarily or permanently suspended due to violations of our Terms of Service:


 m**g*uu

 *에좋*인*


We do not yet have a high number of players that have faced suspension. We are in the process of implementing better and more efficient ways to address teaming, inactivity, stalking, and even attempts to use illegal programs.

We will do our best to improve this and make sure that these issues do not ruin the fun and unique experiences we want you to have in Eternal Return.
If your account has been suspended and you would like to appeal your case, please contact us through:

notes.notes:
New character - Sissela
Sissela, the Incurable Patient, joins us as the 14th character to join Eternal Return. Keep an eye out for her in your matches starting from tomorrow!
Agony (Passive)

 As Sissela's HP decreases, she gains HP regeneration and skill amplification.
 HP regeneration per second : 2/4/6 ~ 18/20/22 (is not affected by the increase rate of HP regen)

 When Wilson returns to Sissela, her next normal attack deals 18 (+1.2 AP)(+ Sissela's current level * 10) damage and reduces the movement speed of enemies by 10/20/30% for 2 seconds. This effect can be activated every 3 seconds.

Play With Us! (E)

notes.title: Ban Policy (Active from Sissela Update)
notes.notes:
Players found to be violating terms of service of the game will be subject to punishment based on the severity of the violation.

Bannable cases may include, but are not limited to:


 Repeated insulting and harassing to other players in the game chat
 Intentional teaming between players in ways that the system does not presuppose in each game mode.
*Repeated reported cases of two or more players collaborating in eliminating other players in matches will be considered as teaming
*Strategical decisions in the last safe zone like focusing a harder to kill character or one with less HP will likely not be considered teaming
 Repeated cases of AFK in team modes
 Usage of illegal programs in the game
 Attempted impersonation of Nimble Neuron staff
 Any other violation of the Terms of Service (https://www.playeternalreturn.com/terms-of-service)


Banning can take two different forms:


 Temporary ban: 3 days, 7 days, 1 month.
 Permanent ban: Indefinite revocation of access to the game with said account.

* If a player has received two temporary bans, the third one will become a permanent ban
* Players are responsible for their own account. If you lend your account to another person, and said person violates TOS, the account owner will be held responsible.

Players will not receive a notification upon their account being banned.

To issue a ban appeal, submit a message to our support center using the Issue category: Ban
This can be found here: https://eternalreturn.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/requests/new

New character - Xiukai
Xiukai is the 13th character to enter Lumia Island. Watch out for the Juggernaut Chef.
...not like he’s hard to miss! 

Juggernaut Chef (Passive)

 Food and beverages made by Xiukai have 30% bonus recovery. When crafting a food item of Uncommon or higher rarity, he earns a stack of Juggernaut Chef, increasing his max HP by 7 for each stack.

Heavy Meal (W)

 Xiukai slams his giant wok on the ground, dealing 60/100/140/180/220(+0.3 AP) damage in an area around him and reducing the movement speed of enemies hit by 10/20/30/40/50% for 1.5 seconds.
 Enemies with impaired movement receive an additional damage (3/3.5/4/4.5/5% of Xiukai's max HP) and their movement speed is reduced for an additional 1.5 seconds.

 Enemies with impared movement receive additional damage (1.5/2/2.5/3/3.5% of Xiukai's max HP) and are knocked airborne for 1 second.

 Xiukai dishes out fire from his wok 6 times in 3 seconds, dealing 75/125/175(+0.5 AP) damage to enemies in a cone in front of him. (+ stacks of Juggernaut Chef).
 Enemies with impaired movement have their defense reduced by 10/15/20% for 3 seconds.



Game

Solo mode - 18 players
Look at em all here on Lumia!

 Solo mode now has 18 players. 
 Decreased balance differences between maps for Duo, Squad, and Solo modes by matching the number of players in a game.


Team mode - Ally indicator and crawling
Dude hide in the bush so I can res you.

 An indicator has been added to the minimap that shows which direction your allies are moving.
 You can focus the camera on your allies by pressing F2/ F3, or their character portrait on the minimap. 
 You can now crawl on the ground when downed.
 Sound effects have been added when an ally has been downed or revived.
 Chat announcements for downed or dead teammates are now clearly distinguished.
 When an ally is fighting, an icon appears next to their character portrait.
 Adjustments for team mode no longer appear for characters that haven’t received any.


Bigger boxes
It’s not even a gift to me, why am I getting excited?

 Small boxes now contain 3 materials instead of 2, and medium-sized boxes contain 4 instead of 3. Large boxes still contain 5.
 Increased the number of materials per area by 20%. (see details in the Area section)


Tamer wild animals
Hi doggy!

 Wild animals and Wickeline no longer attack first.

 Bat, Boar: 60s

 Bear: 180s

vs AI mode improvements
Finally the bots are leaving me alone

 Bots will stop chasing players earlier.


Shortcut added
Accommodating all play styles

 Now able to move the camera with the arrow keys if camera focus is deactivated.


Others
Clarity

 Added an "in combat" indicator that appears next to character portraits on the minimap.
 Added sound effects for installing traps and consuming food and beverages.
 Character stats are expressed as whole numbers. Also added "max skill amplification" number to characters stats.
 Changed color of chat announcements for Tree of Life and Wickeline for easier distinguishing.
 Improved optimization for map objects.


Balance Changes
There’s a lot here. We’re always listening, so read up on what we tweaked based on what you’ve given us!

Attack range is a very important factor for characters, but it has been overlooked in Eternal Return. We want to make a clear difference so that characters that are attacking from close-range, whether it’s melee or close ranged, the closer character can gain a bit of a benefit from closing the gap.

Although the individuality and characteristics of weapons are important fun factors, we don’t want any particular weapon to feel useless. In particular, we are trying to keep normal attack damage reduction and skill damage reduction properly balanced.

Food is important in a starting route, we’ve reduced the efficiency of food that you can make in just one area.

Skill feedback always takes the longest to reflect in-game. First, we’re reading all the feedback you give us and we try to determine what we can change right away. For example, to adjust the oft requested cast time of Magnus's Broken Bullet (Q), we also need to adjust the animation, which will take approximately 1 to 2 months. We try to find a much easier way of fixing this - like increasing the range and seeing how that works. Naturally, there are skills that will take time to change no matter what, like Dual Sword Rampage, which we received feedback about in the CBT -- it’s been adjusted.

We can't always respond to a lot of feedback about balance, but we are always listening and trying to improve thanks to you.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.13.0 (2020. 7. 29)
notes.notes:
New Character - Hyejin
Lumia Island welcomes its 12th character: Hyejin!

Three Calamities (Passive)

 When Hyejin hits an enemy with a skill, they receive a calamity. Upon reaching 3 stacks, Three Calamities is activated, fearing them for 1/1.5/2 seconds. Feared enemies cannot receive Three Calamities again for 5 seconds.


Charm of Despair (Q)

 Hyejin casts a Charm of Despair in the targeted direction, dealing 100/125/150/175/200 (+0.3 AP) damage to the first enemy hit, and reducing their movement speed by 50% for 1 second.
 She can recast the skill to cast another charm.
Cooldown: 20/18/16/14/12s, Recast Time: 2s, range 11.75m


Charm of the Prophecy (W)

 Hyejin summons a Charm of the Prophecy in the targeted location that stays at the location for up to 3 seconds. Charm of Prophecy ignites after the max time, or if the skill is activated again, dealing damage to enemies in range and rooting them for 1 second.
 Charm of the Prophecy damage increases while on the ground, dealing 15/20/25/30/35(+0.3 AP) to 140/205/270/335/400(+0.3 AP) damage.


Charm of the Nomad (E)

 Hyejin casts a Charm of the Nomad in the targeted location, dealing 45/70/95/120/145(+0.3 AP) damage to enemies hit.
 Activating the skill again teleports Hyejin to the location of Charm of the Nomad, dealing 45/70/95/120/145(+0.3 AP) damage to enemies upon landing.


Five Omens (R)

 Hyejin focuses for 1 second, summoning 5 Omens, and dealing 150/275/400(+0.7 AP) damage to enemies in an area around her.
 The Omens spin around Hyejin for 20 seconds, each dealing 100/140/180(+0.5 AP) damage to enemies hit. Omens are consumed after hitting an enemy.
 While focusing, her movement speed is reduced by 30%. Hyejin can teleport to her Charm of the Nomad location while focusing.


Game System

Skill Collision improvements

 Character and wild animal collision range increased. All skill shot's hitboxes have been improved.
 Character “peeking range” is now wider, making it easier to target an enemy.
 Targeting range of melee weapons with Attack Move (A + click) increased, making kiting for melee weapons a bit smoother.
 Corrected a targeting error due to differences in terrain. Fixed a bug where skill direction was slightly wrong when your mouse was in a location that was higher/lower than your character, like buildings.
 Corrected an issue with incorrect projectile trajectories if the projectile's length or width differed from the skill area indicator.
 Branches, stones, and potatoes are not affected by collision anymore. You can step on these collectibles or use movement skills without being blocked.


Downed/death implementation
With Duo and Squad modes, we also introduced the "downed" state. We realized that this "downed state" could use some more clarity.

 When downing an opponent, it will count as a "Kill", and most of the effects related to enemy kills will be activated: players will gain experience from eliminating a player - including weapon and armor masteries and player kill count will increase. Effects that are activated on kills will also be applied once you down an enemy. (ex: Jackie's passive)
 When "full killing" a player in a downed state, kill effects and passives will not be activated. You will only be able to loot items from their corpse.
 For the cases without Downed state (Solo mode, Last remaining survivor on a team), killing an enemy will grant you XP and effects from kills.


Traps and cameras improvement

 From now on, traps and cameras will have a special HP bar consisting of 6-8 "segments" (twice the amount of the previous HP it had).
 Each weapon will have different ways of taking out summoned objects.
 Melee, throwing, and shuriken normal attacks will remove 3 segments of the HP bar. Dual swords and other ranged attacks will remove 2 segments. Assault Rifle attacks will remove 1 segment.


Improvements for Duo and Squad modes
This update focuses more on improving small features. The upcoming updates will bring much more additions to team modes.

 Actions of team members will be displayed with different colors marked on the minimap.
 When one of your teammates uses the Hyperloop, the arrival destination will be displayed in chat.
 Ping shapes like the question mark and exclamation mark are made a bit more intuitive.
 Wild animals now don't attack downed enemies.


Wickeline and wild animals

Wickeline
Buff for killing Wickeline: 60+(Wickeline level-15) * 10 every 3 second —> 120 + (Wickeline level - 15) * 20
 Partially added Wickeline's voice lines.
Wild dog
 Probability of dropping Lighter and Gunpowder increased 2x.
 Attacks per second 1 → 0.9
 Wolf 
Attack power per level 20 → 22 (Initial AP 40 → 44)


Masteries
We're adjusting masteries that have a high average compared to other masteries in order to smooth differences in player levels during a match. We also slightly increased the team mode bonus when losing a teammate.

 Crafting Mastery
 Crafting XP reduced: Uncommon (300 —> 200), Rare (500—>350), Epic (800 —> 600), Legendary (1300 —> 1000)
 Search Mastery reduced
 Collectibles 200 —> 160, Air Supplies 420 —> 350, Boxes 90 —> 80
 Movement Mastery
 Mastery gained for moving into a new area reduced 200 —> 180
 XP gained for killing a player reduced: 300 + 100 —> 200 per level of the dead player + 60 per level of the dead player
 Bonus XP per level difference with the highest level player: 12% → 15%
 Bonus XP in team mode following teammates that died 12%/25% → 15%/30%


Shortcuts

 Zoom in/out on minimap: default shortcuts set to + and - keys.
 Toggle nickname/HP/SP feature: no default shortcut set. You can set this shortcut in the game settings.


Balance changes

Weapon skills

 Tonfa weapon skill: Quick Spin
 Damage returned before reduced defense 100/130% —> 50/70%
 Now immune to damage but does not block status effects


Character

Jackie
We are trying to balance out Jackie, who can use 4 different weapons, so that she has similar effects with every weapon. We're going to increase stability for the relatively weak two-handed sword and dual swords, while adjusting core items for the relatively strong dagger.
Activating Bloodfest is one of the reasons for Jackie's weakness in team modes. The goal is to be compensated because it is more difficult, and important, to put the enemy into a downed state than attacking a downed enemy.

 Bloodfest will now be activated when downing an enemy in team modes.
 Jackie's two-handed sword normal attack speed increased: 0.625 → 0.65 per second.

 HP Regen 10/16/22/28/34 —> 12/19/26/33/40


Nadine
Nadine has become slightly too dependent on Monkey Wire (E) and Wolf Assault (R).
Our goal is to tone down her ult power and encourage the use of Bullseye (Q) and Squirrel Trap(W). The expansion of collision range and the improvement of traps will also help these two skills.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 0.12.1 (2020. 7. 8)
notes.notes:
New character - Yuki

 Perfect Fit (Passive) 
 Yuki stores cufflinks as a resource. Upon damaging an enemy, he consumes a stored cufflink, dealing an additional 15/30/45 true damage.
 Yuki recovers 1 cufflink every 4 seconds while out of combat.
 Activating Button Up will refill all of his cufflinks.
 From Head to Toe (Q)
 Yuki's next normal attack deals 40/80/120/160/200 damage and reduces the movement speed of enemies by 50% for 1 second.
 Consuming a cufflink stuns enemies for 0.5 seconds.
 Button Up (W)
 Passive: reduces cooldown of Button Up by 0.5 seconds each time Yuki takes damage.
 Yuki straightens up his outfit for 1 second and reduces the cooldown for Dashing Gentleman by 4/5/6/7/8. While using Button Up, his defense is increased by 50%. When Button Up is complete, he refills his cufflinks.
 Dashing Gentleman (E)
 Yuki dashes 2m in the targeted direction, dealing 70/130/190/250/310(+0.6 AP) damage to the first enemy hit. Enemies hit are disarmed, disabling their normal attacks for 1.25 seconds.
 Coup de Grace (R)
 Yuki unsheaths his sword and slashes an area in front of him, dealing an initial 250/375/500(+1.5 AP) damage to enemies and leaving a mark, reducing movement speed of enemies by 70% for 1 second.
 The mark explodes after Yuki sheathes his sword, dealing true damage equal to 15/20/25% of the enemy's max HP.

New features

 Added a new shortcut for Attack Move. There is no default shortcut, but you can set up a new one in your settings. This shortcut has the same effects as the [A] key.

Game

 Downed State
 HP 200 —> 500
 Damage reduction 90% —> 75% + 0.8% per level
 Bonus XP after teammate death 10%/20% —> 12/25%
 Reduction of the number of Waters provided at the start of the game 3 → 2
 Mode Adjustments added per character. Damage, damage taken, HP recovery, and defense will vary in Solo, Duo, and Squad modes for each character.

notes.title: Closed Beta - Patch Notes [June 24th]
notes.notes:
Hello my dear friends and future Eternal Return Beta Testers! GM Aesop here with a list of all the updates and changes we've made since the 5th Alpha -- also known as patch notes!
We originally pushed back our start date for the Beta test about one month, so we are coming back with even MORE updates for the test starting tomorrow.
Buckle up because there's a lot here. Let's get started. 

[Character]

New character: Isol
Isol, the Guerilla, will be one of the two new characters coming to Eternal Return starting at the beta. He's a trap/mine/bomb focused character who uses assault rifles. An outline of his skills is as follows:
[Passive] Guerilla Warfare

 Isol arms traps in 0.4/0.3/0.2 seconds, and his traps become invisible 1/1.2/1.4 seconds faster. Enemies that take damage from a trap of his have their defense reduced by 5/15/25% for 3 seconds. Photographic Memory: if an enemy sets a trap in Isol's vision range, he remembers the trap, preventing it from going invisible for him. 

[Q] Semtex Bomb: 
 Range: 8m, Cooldown: 20/18/16/14/12 seconds, SP cost: 60/80/100/110/130
Isol throws a bomb to the target location that sticks to an enemy or on the ground. If the bomb is thrown on the ground or sticks to an enemy, it explodes after 5 seconds, dealing 50/75/100/125/150 (+0.5 AP) damage and rooting enemies caught in the blast. If the bomb is stuck to an enemy, each attack reduces its timer by 1 second and increases the damage of the explosion by 10/18/26/34/42 (+0.5 AP).
[W] Rebel Assault:
 Range: 8m, Cooldown: 20/18/16/14/12 seconds, SP cost: 70/80/90/100/110
 Isol unleashes a fury of bullets in front of him, dealing 20/40/60/80/100, and reducing the movement speed of enemies.
[E] Camouflage:
 Distance: 3m, Cooldown: 25/23/21/19/17 seconds, SP cost: 130
 Isol rolls forward and blends into his surroundings, going invisible for 3.5/4/4.5/5/5.5 seconds. While invisible, his movement speed is increased by 10/15/20/25/30%. The invisibility is lifted if Isol does any action other than movement.
[R] MOK Operational Mine: 
 Cooldown: 30/20/10 seconds, SP cost: 80
 Isol installs a MOK Operational Mine on the ground that detects enemies. The mine explodes when an enemy enters its range, dealing 60/100/140(+0.5 AP) damage and reducing the movement speed of enemies by 10/20/30% for 2 seconds.
 MOK Operational Mine is not affected by skill amplification or reduction but is affected by trap masteries.

New character: Li Dailin
Our other new character is Li Dailin, the Spirited Master. She's bringing melee-based combat while using the glove weapon. She also has a new resource, BAC. Her abilities don't cost mana, but will vary depending on how high her BAC is. Check them here: 
[Passive] Blood Alcohol Content (BAC) 
 Li Dailin can use Drink Up to fill her BAC bar. When her BAC is above 40, she gains Tipsy, giving her skills extra effects, and gaining Dailed In for her next normal attack.
 If her BAC reaches 100, she becomes Inebriated, is silenced for 7 seconds and gains Dialed In.
 Dialed In: Li Dailin's next normal attack will trigger twice. Her second attack deals 40/60/80% damage.
 Strong Stomach: Li Dailin's attack speed is increased by 10/20/30% after drinking an alcoholic beverage item. 

[Q] Spirited Kick: 
 Range: 2.5m, Cooldown: 10 seconds
 Li Dailin kicks forward, dealing 20/40/60/80/100 damage to enemies hit. She can reactivate this skill two more times.
 Tipsy: Increases range and increases damage dealt to 60%.

[W] Drink Up: 
 Cooldown: 8/7/6/5/4 seconds
 Li Dailin takes a drink for 0.8 seconds, gaining Liquid Strength and increasing her BAC by 45. While drinking, she avoids normal attacks and takes less damage from skills.
 Liquid Strength: the damage from her next normal attack and damage from Dialed In is increased depending on her BAC.

[E] Bottom Shelf: 
 Range: 4m, Cooldown: 13/12/11/10/9 seconds
 Li Dailin spits out cheap liquor in a cone in front of her, silencing enemies in range for 0.6/0.8/1/1.2/1.4 seconds and dealing 80/125/170/215/260 damage. 
 Tipsy: Reduces movement speed of enemies by 20%.
[R] Striking Tiger:
 Range: 8m, Cooldown: 110/90/70 seconds
 Li Dailin launches forward, suppressing the first enemy hit and following it up with two consecutive kicks. Each blow deals 40/70/100(+0.2 AP) to 120/210/300(+0.6 AP) damage in proportion to the enemy's missing HP.
 Tipsy: follows up with 4 consecutive kicks.

Fiora

 Fiora's skill effects and sounds have been improved.
 The range of her Q skill has increased by 1m.


[New modes] Duo and Squad modes
You asked for it, so you got it! Two new modes, Duo and Squad, have been added to the game.

 Duo and Squad have a total of 18 players in each match.
 Team members' portraits stay next to the minimap, and there are specific loading screens and scoreboards.
 When a player's HP reaches 0, that player is downed and team members can revive them by clicking on them.
 You will receive LP separately for each mode: Solo, Duo, and Squad. In the future, account levels will be integrated and the Match-Making Rating (MMR) will operate separately for each mode.


[New features] - Lobby
We made some nice improvements to the Lobby to make it look a bit nicer and added some more stuff. You can play with your Steam friends, there are quests for bonus A-Coin, and some other new additions. 
Custom Games

 Custom Games have been added. You can now create private matches with your friends.
 Only Solo mode will be playable in custom games during the CBT.

Account level and daily quests

 Account levels have been added.
 Daily Quests have been added. There will be 3 missions to complete daily.
 Account levels are implemented in the CBT for testing, and will be reset by Early Access.

Steam friends

 Steam Friends compatibility has been added.
 You will be able to invite friends to the game, or add/delete them.
 You can create your team ahead of a match by inviting your Steam Friends. The team created can be used for Duo or Squad modes.

Background changes

 The lobby has a brand new 3D background. The background now feels a bit more natural when looking at character animations.


[New features] - Game
A lot of new features are in the game now. New mid game objective and communication methods. I’ll go into more detail below.
Tree of Life
Reach a mid/late game power spike without having to rely on luck drops from bears. 

 An Ancient Tree where you can now collect Tree of Life has been added in Hotel, Forest, and Cemetery.
 You will be able to collect it at fixed times only once. (it will appear once during the day on Day 2, once during the night on Day 2 and once during the day on Day 3 in the following order: Hotel, Forest, Cemetery)
 Collecting it takes 7 seconds.
 Wolves and bears no longer drop Tree of Life.

Ping & Pin
Pings are like “On the way!” “Danger!” “Back up!” ”Assist me!”  Pins are things you place on the map to indicate where you want to go, what item you want, etc.

 If you hold Ctrl + click on the map, you can put a pin on the target you want. Your team members can all see your pin, and putting new pins won't make the old ones disappear.
 If you hold Alt + click, you can send signals to your team members like retreat, danger, assistance and on the way.

Chat
We’ll be keeping an eye on chat so be on your best behavior!

 You can now chat with your team members while in match.
 Information will also be provided in the chat like Wickeline entering the island, the spawning of Tree of Life, pings, etc.

New shortcuts
Also some new settings.

 You can change every shortcut except pings and pins in the game settings. The fast-crafting shortcut will especially be useful.
 Fast crafting immediately crafts the item located on the far left among the items in the quick crafting list
 Alt + left-click: Ping
 Ctrl + left-click: Pin
 Shift + left-click(item): designates a target item
 Shift + right-click(inventory item): drops the item immediately
 Z: expand the chat
 Swap left and right click: you can now enable/disable that feature
 You can now enable/disable the UI and HUD in the settings

New item effect - Bleeding. 

 There are a couple new items with bleeding and the effect has also been added to some old items. Bleeding reduces the healing of enemies from your skills or normal attacks. Detail below in the [Balance] section.

Small snack
Yum

 You will now be provided with 2 water and 3 bread at the start of the game.

[Improvements]
We’ve made tons of improvements across the board - small and large. There’s a lot of detail here so just check them out below.
Wickeline
The lass is a little more worth killing.

  The entry of Wickeline on the island is now announced in the chat.
  The player that kills Wickeline will get a VF buff. The VF buff deals a fixed amount of damage for normal attacks and skills for 3 seconds.

Minimap
The minimap looks mighty magical

 The terrain representation of the minimap has been simplified. In particular, cross-regional boundaries and routes have been improved.
 A zoom in/out function has been added.
 If the camera goes outside of the minimap, the minimap now follows it.
 Surveillance cameras and traps of the enemy team are now indicated in red, while allies are indicated in blue.

Optimization
Making ER accessible for all!

 You can toggle vertical synchronization in the settings.
 Packet optimization: performance has been improved when detecting poor network connections.
 When graphic settings are set on low, decorative objects are not displayed. (background ornaments, patterns, etc.)

Character voices and sound effects
I bet you didn't know you can press CTRL+1/2/3/4/5/6 to listen to the extra voice lines!

 Voice lines have been added when using certain skills.
 Character voice volume has been reduced when there are announcements.
 We've adjusted the frequency of triggering of random voice lines.
 Boxes shake slightly when opened, and there are different sound effects depending on the material of the box.
 Sound effects have been added for various situations, such as time counters for restricted areas, item acquisition, and dropping items.
 Sound effects have been added when hovering or clicking on lobby buttons.

Matchmaking
From the matchmakers of Nimble Neuron

 The matchmaking algorithm has been completely replaced so that players with vast MMR differences do not meet.

Other improvements
Basically everything that doesn't belong in a category. Extra tweaks and small improvements to the game, fighting, etc.

 Added skill amplification to weapons mastery. (Details in the Balance section)
 Ingredients that will be used for crafting will now blink when crafting or hovering over fast crafting. It will be easier to notice when you press the crafting button by mistake or are about to consume an item you need for an armor.
 We've improved a number of in-game tooltips.
 When in battle, a combat mark is added next to the portrait.
 Added the effect of slightly darkening the screen when your character hides.
 Detailed vegetation and decorations have been added to the background.
 The conditions for the number of people accelerating the restricted area have been eased.
 Players will get an experience bonus in game if there is a vast level difference between survivors.
 The announcer informs you when 10, 5, 3, or 2 survivors remain.
 Attack animations have been improved when continuously attacking. Attack and recovery effects have also been improved to make them more visible.
 Left-clicking a wild animal displays its skills and items.
 The direction in which wild animals are looking in the beginning is now random.
 Improved the item placement algorithm for boxes, reducing the number of identical items in other item boxes.
 The game results window has been improved.
 Tutorials have been improved with more details. 
 Isol has been added as a bot AI.
 When Zahir's Q (Narayanastra) is used outside of its range, he now walks to the target point and uses it instead of using it at its maximum range.
 The rapier weapon skill has been changed to pass through walls.
 The camera has been pulled back a little bit, giving you a wider viewing angle.
 Camera focus options will be remembered when the game is restarted.
 You can now craft and cook in combat.
 The time to start Resting and crafting is slightly reduced.

[Bug fixes]
Lumia Island is home to many different animals and wildlife but we try to keep it clear of bugs.

 Fixed the bug concerning item bonuses that increased all experience.
 Multiple corrections to cases where the box does not open on the first attempt.
 Several modifications to effects of characters coming from locations outside of the vision range.
 Corrected bugs concerning automatic attacks when using the Hyperloop.
 Fixed a bug regarding auto attacking enemies in bushes.
 Improved the use of Magnus’s Ult (Motorcycle - corrected wall bugs, improved judgment, etc.)
 Fixed the bug when Hart's Delay (Q) skill reached its full charge and the indicator was wrong
 Fixed the bug where explosive traps only hurt the person who stepped on the trap.
 Corrected the Dagger Tooltip to show the normal amount of critical damage.
 Corrected the bug where Jackie's attack power greatly increased even when not using the axe weapon skill.
 Corrected the bug where Aya's passive cooldown was reduced by traps.
 Corrected problems where the weapon skill cooldown is not updated when changing weapon type.
 Fixed problems where traps in bushes weren’t activating properly.
 Fixed bugs where characters automatically attacked surrounding enemies when fishing or collecting items.
 Damage received when less than 1 is now rounded up to 1.
 Fixed problems of skillshots being fired in wrong directions when used in areas where it's impossible to move. 

[Balance Changes]
We’ve added skill amplification to a lot of masteries. A lot of stats have been tweaked. A couple items have been removed. [Bleeding]is on a couple items. A few new items have been added. Some recipes have been changed.

notes.title: Balance and Patch Notes - 5th Alpha Test 3rd Weekend
notes.notes:
Hey guys, GM Aesop here with another of our weekly balance changes for the 5th Alpha. Let's take a look.

General


 Reducing the acceleration of restricted areas
 Restricted areas are designated quicker if there is a low number of survivors. Now, the number of survivors that cause the acceleration has been lowered and the acceleration will be a bit reduced until the 2nd day.

notes.title: Balance and Patch Notes - 5th Alpha Test 2nd Weekend
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. GM Aesop here. Yesterday, we showed you some stats regarding the win rates and things regarding different characters. We’ve taken some of your feedback, along with the game data, to make some changes.

General Changes

Wild animals
We're reducing the amount of mastery XP you get when killing wild animals by just a bit, but hunting has become easier and there are now more wild animals.
Number of wild animals increased. 13 chickens, 4 bats, 7 boars, 7 wild dogs, 5 wolves, and 2 bears are entering the island!
The amount of mastery XP gained from dealing damage to and taking damage from wild animals has been significantly reduced. Instead, we're increasing the XP gained from killing wild animals.
The attack power/attack speed/defense/HP of wild animals has been reduced by 10~20%.
When wolves use their Howling skill, you will only be attacked by a maximum of 2 wolves.

Resources
Pond: 
4 Surveillance Cameras deleted
4 Walther PPK added
Avenue
3 Walther PPK deleted
3 Surveillance Cameras added
Beach
4 Long Rifles, 3 Fedorova, 1 Can of Cola, 1 Carbonated Water, 1 Mousetrap deleted.
5 Gemstones and 5 Pickaxes added
Masteries
Additional Defense Mastery XP given when hunting wild animals.
For every 100 damage dealt to wild animals, the amount of weapon mastery received has been reduced from 30 to 5 and hunting mastery has been reduced from 50 to 40.
For every 100 damage taken from wild animals, the amount of defense mastery received has been reduced from 35 to 10 and hunting mastery reduced from 50 to 10.
For every 100 damage taken, you receive 15 Health mastery, down from 30.
For every 50m moved, you now gain 55 movement mastery, down from 50.
Fixed a bug where clicking a box wouldn't open it

Optimization
 Added a setting allowing you to manually adjust the FPS cap. FPS is automatically capped at 60, but you can adjust it in Settings > Screen > FPS cap. If your PC is powerful enough, you can go up to 120 FPS, softening the image. You can also lower the cap if your PC is a bit weaker, allowing you to have a more steady experience.
 We fixed a backend bug that that occured when collecting real-time information from all the players (e.g., items, crafting, mastery, etc.) in your match. There is no change in what you'll see, but this bugfix should help those who experienced "mini" frame lag in-game. (Some players who experienced this called it "mini lag" where your character would move forward normally and then snap backwards just a bit)

notes.title: Patch Notes: 5th Alpha Test
notes.notes:
Hello my dear friends! Nimble Neuron’s GM Aesop here with patch notes for the upcoming 5th Alpha test. 
BS:ER is still under development, as I’m sure you’re aware, and the game will continue to be improved well into the future. We also read all of your feedback from our 4th Alpha Test and took a lot of it into consideration when developing the game and making changes.

We hope that these patch notes help you further enjoy BS:ER!

[Character]

New character: Hart
Hart, the Peacekeeper, will be taking center stage on Lumia Island. Along with the power of music, she’ll be bringing her own unique weapon type - Guitars.
She will also be featuring a new “Evolution” system. The first time she crafts an Uncommon Guitar, a rare Guitar, or an epic Guitar, she gains 1 evolution point, so you’ll get a max of 3. You can then choose a skill to evolve, granting improvements to your abilities, which you can check out here:


Feedback (Passive)
If Hart deals damage to an enemy with a normal attack, she recovers 1/1.5/2% of her SP. 
When evolved: an additional sound wave is discharged with every normal attack, dealing .25AP damage. She discharges one additional sound wave per Evolution point. 
Q - Delay 
Hart strums her guitar, charging her sound waves. When she strums the guitar again, the charged sound waves are released. She can charge for up to 4 seconds, and maintain the sound wave for 4 seconds. She deals 60-180/80-240/100-300/120-360/140-420 (+0.2-0.6 AP) damage, depending on how long she charges. 
When evolved: Reduces the movement speed of enemies hit. Movement speed reduction increases per number of Evolution points.
W - Overdrive
Hart plays a lick on her guitar, increasing her Attack Power for 5 seconds.
When evolved: Reduces enemies' defense to her next sound wave. (Does not affect Weapon Skills.) 
E - Flanger
Hart quickly dashes in the targeted direction. She can activate this skill an additional two times.  She moves 2m and strums her guitar, discharging sound waves in a 4m area around her and dealing 20/30/40/50/60 (+0.3AP) damage to enemies hit
When evolved: Activating this skill grants skill damage amplification for 4 seconds. This effect stacks up to 3 times. The amplification amount increases per number of Evolution points.
R - Peacemaker
Hart puts on a show for 5 seconds, causing all her enemies in a 7/8/9m range around her  to dance. For every second of her performance, she recovers HP. Enemies attending the concert have their movement speed reduced 
When evolved: Reduces the SP of all dancing per second. SP reduction amount increases per number of Evolution Points.


[Balance Changes]
We’re really tweaking numbers and working on finding a good fit for every character and their favorite items. Almost every single weapon has been adjusted from the last Alpha. If I were to list every single item and change, these patch notes would be more like a patch novel! 
It’s been a few months since our last test, so we’ve made a lot  of changes. However, going forward, we plan to have more frequent, minor, changes as opposed to infrequent large ones. 


Item builds

Many different builds and items have been adjusted to help reinforce strategic characteristics of each item. In our previous test, items were largely divided into basic attack focused builds and skill driven builds -- traps excluded.
We’ve worked to clarify options between early and late game choices or skill types. For example, a build may be focused on auto attacks and would center around attack speed and critical hits, but you can also try and build extra normal attack damage  
We’ve tweaked some numbers around Skill Damage Increasing items. Skill damage increases come in two forms: Skill Damage Increase (%) and flat Skill Damage Increase. Our aim is to make percentage based increases good for powerful skills with long cooldowns, and flat increases better suited towards skills with shorter cooldowns or  sustained damage.
We’ve improved the efficiency of items for HP regen, SP regen, movement speed, vision range, and attack range. With the new zoom out feature, items with vision range are particularly stronger as you get a wider field of view.
We’ve lowered the rarity of some relatively easy to craft Epic items, like those with 4 materials, to Rare.
The recipes of various items have changed.

The rarities of many items have also changed. All recipes and stats on the Gamepedia, seen here, are up to date: 
https://blacksurvivaleternalreturn.gamepedia.com/Item


Traps
Traps now have a cast time to set.
Overall trap damage has been reduced

Mastery
Wild animals now give more experience initially, but additional experience decreases depending on level.
Animals now give 10% more experience in the beginning of the match and up to 5% less at their highest level.
Trap crafting experience has been reduced from 10%
Trap mastery level bonus damage has been reduced from 5% to 4%
Operating the CCTV console now grants a bit of searching experience.


[Weapon Skills]
Hart is bringing her Guitar to the mix, so that means another cool new weapon skill. Just like all the other weapon skills, each weapon type's unique skills can be unlocked at Mastery Lv. 7 and Enhanced and Mastery Lv. 14. There were also some tweaks to the other weapons skills.
Guitar - Love &...
Release a sound wave in the targeted direction, dealing 1.25AP / 2AP damage to the first enemy hit. Enemies hit by the sound wave are possessed by the music, moving towards the source of the wave for 2 seconds.
Weapon Skill Changes
Sniper (Sniper Rifle):
Cast time 2 seconds - > 1 second
Quick Cut (Rapier): 
Damage: 2AP -> 1AP 
Quick Cut will now always critically strike, dealing 2x damage. 
Cooldown: 30 > 15 seconds at second level.
Overheat (Assault Rifle)
At level skill level 1, the knockback applies to every 3rd attack.
At skill level 2, the knockback applies to every attack,
Expulsion Shot (Crossbow)
Knockback distance: 4m -> 5m

[What’s New?]
Store
Your one stop shop for all things BS:ER!
The store is open. It will be the place for you to purchase all of your favorite BS:ER characters with new currencies, A-Coin and NP.
Voices
Am I crazy or am I hearing voices?
Sure, the ambient sounds of Lumia are great and all, but the addition of character voices make it sound even better! The playable characters will have voice lines in English and Korean! You can pick which one you want to listen to! There are specific voice lines for specific situations, so be sure you play a lot and try and hear them all.
New items
With the addition of Hart, she will gain access to Guitar item type. Following that, 16 different guitars have been added. 
Two items that we carried over from the original Black Survival will be changed. “Holy Blood” is now “VF Blood Sample” and the “Arcane Stone” is now “Force Core”. 
Tutorial
Getting started in Lumia can be a challenge.
We’ve created a tutorial with your favorite serial killer, Jackie, showing you the ropes of Lumia. It’s a great resource to help players, new and old, discover how to play and fully experience all that BS:ER has to offer.
Item descriptions
Some items have had their descriptions updated.
Gun descriptions now display the gun’s max ammo.
Traps now display effects, such as slows, roots, etc.
New Languages:
Russian
Thai
Vietnamese
New Loading Screen Image
While the game loads in, before you select your starting weapon and area, there’s a nice new image. Pretty.



[Improvements]
Map improvements
..I think I’ve been here before
We added some cool landmarks all round the map and gave Lumia a little more life to help remind you where you are at a glance.
Many item boxes have been changed to more properly match the region.
The Alley has been made smaller, but the number of items remains the same, improving efficiency. 
New item icons
BS:ER has tons of items and our art team is working hard on making the icons for them all look awesome, so we updated some old ones and added new ones for items that didn’t have icons yet.
Initial Restricted Area changes
Where are you gonna start first?
The first restricted areas will not be immediately assigned at the start of the game. This’ll give you all some more time to explore and move around the map and allows for more dynamic gameplay. 
Zoom out
Whenever you equip an item that increases your vision range, your camera will zoom out a bit and give you an extended view of the area around you.
Navigation / UI
My UI is so clean now!
The in-game UI now displays materials you can hunt/collect.
The yellow triangle is your friend! The yellow triangle in the top left of the item icon will appear wherever the item is found. If there’s no yellow triangle, it’s not in your targeted items, and you’re free to delete it.
Targeted Items in game
Previously, if you built or crafted something, the item would remain in your “targeted items” area on the top right of your screen. Good news: we fixed that. When you build or loot something in that menu, it’ll disappear. This cleans things up a bit.
When you select targeted items, a little yellow arrow triangle symbol thing would appear on the top left of the icons when you could craft it. That little yellow mark now follows you into your inventory! At a glance, it’s much easier to see what items build into now.
Automatically equip items
Your Headband didn’t disappear from your inventory! You just equipped it!
If you have an empty item slot and you loot or craft something, you’ll automatically equip it and a sound will play alerting you that it happened.Targeted items in inventory
Hyperloops visible on Saved Plans map
Zippin' around Lumia
You can now see hyperloops on the saved plans menu map. You can now more easily devise an extended route for getting all your items.
Total stats in saved plans
The numbers.. What do they mean?!
You can now get an overview of the combined stats of each item you plan on building. You can check this out in the “Saved plans” section when you’re selecting your items!
Better highlighting of containers
Ahh, so the piano wire was in the vending machine this time!
Containers and boxes stand out a lot more, so it’s easier to see them on the map. It’s also easier to see which ones you might’ve missed behind walls or elsewhere.
Japanese fonts are now more readable.




[Bug Fixes]
Like every piece of software ever created, we also had some bugs. Thank you so much everyone for reporting them and helping us recreate and fix them.

Weapon skills:
Glove:  Fixed a bug when using ‘Uppercut’ that caused the additional damage to apply to skills as well, instead of only basic attacks.
Jackie
Fixed a bug where the duration of the bleed effect of her passive went up with her character level. Bleed duration is now fixed at 5 seconds.
Nadine
Fixed a bug where the tooltip for “Squirrel Trap” wasn’t displaying damage correctly.
Zahir
Zahir’s passive, “Eye of Azrael”, is now only activated after killing an enemy.
Traps
You no longer take damage when outside of the range of exploding traps.
Squashed the bug where quickly clicking would install two traps.
